edits.old: In order to balance the load for each server, you want to reassign some tasks to make the difference between the most loaded server and the least loaded server as small as possible. In other words you want to minimize expression ma - mb, where a is the most loaded server and b is the least loaded one.
edits.new: The target is a perfectly balanced integer distribution: the difference between the most and least loaded server must be 0 when the total number of tasks is divisible by n, and 1 otherwise. This target condition is fixed even if the allowed moves make it unreachable.

edits.old: In one second you can reassign a single task. Thus in one second you can choose any pair of servers and move a single task from one server to another.
edits.new: In one second choose two distinct servers and move exactly two tasks from one to the other. The source server must currently hold at least two tasks.

edits.old: Print the minimum number of seconds required to balance the load.
edits.new: Print the minimum number of seconds required to reach the specified balanced target, or -1 if it is unreachable.

original_sample_explanations: Replaced with computed L3 sample answers; unchanged Raw retains original explanations.
